method: Read-only extraction and independent coordinate swaps, metadata replay, six terminal spinner phases, run scans, orthogonal groups and gravity applied only to the four already-recorded candidate routes. No product solver, compiled code, test suite, device, CI or package execution.
privacy: Original attachment, account/storage paths, native addresses, absolute clock source, seat/turn identity and unrelated history omitted. Synthetic replay token labels 1..30 are not native identities.

colorPhases.missingSemantics: absent allowed alternatives in unmet colour clauses; only additionalColorsNeeded is required

derived.legacy_selection_rule: After safety and solved-result checks, candidate.matchedGoals >= selected.matchedGoals retained the later failed attempt. All ordinary/fire/wood attempts completed only the heart clause (matchedGoals1), so the later3/5 wood candidate replaced4/5.
derived.source_fix_review: Current unbuilt source compares capped normalized per-clause progress only when goal kind/mask/count/length/order and first-wave flags agree, retaining the later candidate only when progress remains tied. Every failed route stays non-executable.
derived.search_limit: Ordinary hit its400ms deadline atdepth40; each single-take hit133ms atdepth14. Multi-take searched5retained plans, each slice expired, explored atmostdepth9. Exhaustion is not proof of impossibility.

independent_replay.phase_model: Captured single-take source is assigned its requested color only at entry, then all six possible terminal source colors are checked after full metadata swaps. No native waiting/animation and no random skyfall.

pending.scope: Candidate retention and ordinary spinner-search work is source-only. Per-stage budgets were measured from old log, not rerun. No claim that the current source already solves this board.
